The fact that we didn’t speak despite being in the same school suggests emotional distance or lack of connection at the time.
Personal connections can develop later even after long periods of non-contact.
Moving to a new location (Shreveport) created opportunities for reconnection.
Marriage typically follows meaningful post-acquaintance relationships.
